Benefits of ANZ Direct Auth:
• Secure: ANZ Direct Auth provides a secure way to authorise payments and secure mails in ANZ Direct Online.
• Easy: to activate within ANZ Direct Online.

• Convenient: for users as authorisations can be performed on their smartphone. Great for those payments that have to be authorised urgently when out of the office.
